**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
`{name}` is captured by {sites} and serialized into resume state, but its type is not serializable: {problem}. Create it inside the closure or keep it out of browser code.
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Create the value inside the closure, or capture serializable data (plain objects, signals) instead of class instances, Promises, DOM nodes or WeakMaps.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
declare function makeStore(): { add(): void } & WeakMap<object, 1>;
export function A() { const store = makeStore(); return <button onClick={() => store.add()}>Add</button>; }
```

```tsx prefer
declare function makeStore(): { add(): void };
export function A() { return <button onClick={() => makeStore().add()}>Add</button>; }
```

## When it is reported

Language service only (type-aware, resume files); warning. Not for instances of a class the compiler registers in a resume module (data class or `static [revive]`, the check op's `classes`; T28): those resume (RV2003 / RV2102 cover the ineligible ones).
